changelog:
Major release: Complete overhaul and modernization of the SEO skill with a new unified engine and command structure.

- New unified command-line interface (`/seo [command] [url]`) covering full audits, technical, content, schema, E-E-A-T, Core Web Vitals (INP), images, sitemaps, and more.
- Modular orchestration: 30 SEO sub-skills and 18 sub-agents are now coordinated for industry-adaptive analysis (SaaS, local, e-commerce, publishers, agencies).
- Synthesis framework: Recommendations now follow a clear, evidence- and falsifiability-based 10-principle methodology.
- Expanded runtime and API integration: seamless setup, auto-detection of business type, smart delegation, and audit result synthesis.
- Comprehensive new reference content and removal of legacy/overlapping files; modernized for AI Overviews and generative search.
- New extensions support (Firecrawl, DataForSEO, AI image generation) and detailed PDF report output.
summary: Comprehensive SEO analysis for any website or business type. Full site audits, single-page analysis, technical SEO (crawlability, indexability, Core Web Vitals with INP), schema markup, content quality (E-E-A-T), image optimization, sitemap analysis, and GEO for AI Overviews/ChatGPT/Perplexity. Industry detection for SaaS, e-commerce, local, publishers, agencies. Triggers on: SEO, audit, schema, Core Web Vitals, sitemap, E-E-A-T, AI Overviews, GEO, technical SEO, content quality, page speed.
